page_note: Page is 100% damaged with heavy lacunae. Visible content is a sustained craftsman/vessel analogy describing cosmological process: a craftsman molds and beautifies vessels (jars, bowls, lids) before the king comes to dwell; this is then explicitly applied to the Father of Life and the Third Messenger working in his members. Both sides of the correspondence remain within the cosmic system (craftsman↔Father of Life, vessels↔members, king↔Third Messenger). Segment 5 contains the standard '[Once a]gain' frame formula but immediately pivots into substantive cosmological teaching — classified as mixed. Substrate-dominant page despite damage.
